name: M11-NOV-00b single-control retrieval recovery preregistration
reason: The original bounded run stopped at its final call on an upstream Entrez HTTP 500, after all six positive calls and five control calls completed. Its no-retry rule was honored. This is a separately registered recovery of the one missing control, not a replay of the full panel.

single_call.query: During murine cytomegalovirus infection Qa-1-restricted CD8 T cells
single_call.recency_years: omit; the maintained tool defaults to zero

execution_contract.source: the same maintained local PubMed MCP implementation and response parser as the original result, through one qualified loopback campaign endpoint
execution_contract.credentials: no Entrez API key, email credential, model key, or paid service
execution_contract.campaign_mode: retain COSCIENTIST_REQUIRE_FREE_MODELS=1, one explicitly qualified endpoint and its ephemeral shared secret
execution_contract.cache: use a new empty candidate-arm cache root; retain the original eleven returned-ID records unchanged
execution_contract.error_rule: If the one call has an MCP, upstream, transport, or parser error, stop without another retry; retain the original incomplete comparison and the new error evidence.
execution_contract.result_rule: Append a separate recovery artifact containing status, exact request, parsed PMIDs, anchor/cross-pair flags, timing, keyless/zero-cost proof, and any error class. Never overwrite the original result. Calculate the completed control metrics only if this call succeeds. The primary 0/3 versus 0/3 finding cannot become an adoption under the frozen rule.
